columns.GENERATION_EXPRESSION: (case when (`carrier` = _utf8mb4\'UNITED\') then concat(`lob`,replace(replace(trim(`policy_number`),_utf8mb4\' \',_utf8mb4\'\'),_utf8mb4\'-\',_utf8mb4\'\')) when (`carrier` = _utf8mb4\'GEICO\') then substring_index(trim(`policy_number`),_utf8mb4\'-\',1) else replace(replace(trim(`policy_number`),_utf8mb4\' \',_utf8mb4\'\'),_utf8mb4\'-\',_utf8mb4\'\') end)

(case when ((`carrier` like _utf8mb4\'United%\') or (left(trim(`policy_number`),1) = _utf8mb4\'U\')) then concat(left(replace(trim(`policy_number`),_utf8mb4\' \',_utf8mb4\'\'),3),substr(replace(trim(`policy_number`),_utf8mb4\' \',_utf8mb4\'\'),4)) when ((`carrier` like _utf8mb4\'Progressive%\') and regexp_like(trim(`policy_number`),_utf8mb4\'^(MC|MT|TT|PGR|PWC|BT|Q|GR)\')) then replace(regexp_replace(trim(`policy_number`),_utf8mb4\'^(MC|MT|TT|PGR|PWC|BT|Q|GR)\',_utf8mb4\'\'),_utf8mb4\' \',_utf8mb4\'\') else replace(replace(trim(`policy_number`),_utf8mb4\' \',_utf8mb4\'\'),_utf8mb4\'-\',_utf8mb4\'\') end)
(case when (`policy_prefix` like _utf8mb4\'08 T%\') then _utf8mb4\'TX\' else _utf8mb4\'FL\' end)
